card.name: Ends of drug names and dose units
card.fires_on: Fires on the last piece of a drug name such as Warfarin, or on a unit like mg or /min right after a number. It also fires partway through long words like hypoglycemics or contraceptives in drug-label text.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: The final or middle piece of a split drug or drug-class name, often at the start of an interaction entry.

modes.label: Units after numbers
modes.description: Measures such as mg or /min following a dose or rate number.

card.plain: It marks the point where a drug name or dose unit is being completed in a drug label.
